CMD and TUI clients for the Kernel Service (intloom v<version>)

USAGE intloom [OPTIONS] e2e|build|new|check|inspect|mirror|resume|init|start|stop|status|doctor|recover|looms|runs|run|attach|answer|cancel|pause|operation|wait|watch|artifacts|artifact|records|record|loom|config|mcp|logs|tui

OPTIONS

  --project=<project>    Project directory        
               --json    JSON result or JSON Lines
        --interactive    Allow setup choices      
              --color    Enable color             
              --debug    Debug log filter         
               --info    Info log filter          

COMMANDS

        e2e    Run local Loom E2E cases against its built distribution                     
      build    Build a Loom source package into dist                                       
        new    Create a minimal Loom in a new directory                                    
      check    Check a Loom including TypeScript and packaged imports; preserve dist       
    inspect    Inspect a new Loom source definition and generated plan without executing it
     mirror    Immutable local execution mirrors                                           
     resume    Explicitly resume a paused mirror Run                                       
       init    Initialize project with optional Loom, MCP and Service                      
      start    Start or reuse Service                                                      
       stop    Stop and verify resource release                                            
     status    Verified Service status                                                     
     doctor    Read-only readiness checks                                                  
    recover    Explicit stale-resource cleanup                                             
      looms    Loaded Loom readiness                                                       
       runs    Active Runs and retained history                                            
        run    Run a Loom with the supplied inputs                                         
     attach    Inspect an existing Run                                                     
     answer    Submit the complete Loom answer JSON                                        
     cancel    Explicitly cancel Run                                                       
      pause    Pause after the active Step settles                                         
  operation    Inspect admission receipt                                                   
       wait    Wait for action or terminal; never answer/cancel                            
      watch    Observe snapshots; Ctrl+C closes observation                                
  artifacts    Committed Artifact metadata                                                 
   artifact    Read/export committed snapshot                                              
    records    Committed Record pages                                                      
     record    Read committed Record                                                       
       loom    Offline Loom packages                                                       
     config    Startup configuration                                                       
        mcp    Project MCP setup and stdio bridge                                          
       logs    Read logs; optionally follow Service files                                  
        tui    Persistent terminal UI; also the default entry                              

Use intloom <command> --help for more information about a command.

Run local Loom E2E cases against its built distribution (<entry>)

USAGE <entry> [OPTIONS] [PATH]

ARGUMENTS

  PATH    Local Loom project (defaults to current directory)

OPTIONS

        --root=<root>    Directory for isolated test projects and reports
        --case=<case>    Case ID; omitted selects using the recorded seed
      --entry=<entry>    cmd (default) or mcp                            
        --seed=<seed>    Case selection seed                             
  --profile=<profile>    Model profile YAML or JSON file                 
               --list    List cases without starting a model

USAGE <entry> [OPTIONS] [PATH]
